decoDesc.text: The thickness of the crystalline crust encasing an Originium formation (referred to as Origocrust) is often used to determine the age of the Originium vein.

desc.text: Crystalline crust acquired by delamination of Originium. Can be used to produce other items.

decoDesc.text: Let's chop down some trees first.

desc.text: Common wood that can be gathered in the Mossfield region. Can be used to produce other materials.

decoDesc.text: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Highly Transparent Xiranite Mould. The main materials for constructing this are Packed Origocrust and Xiranite. This mould offers better data transduction when compared to the standard variant.

desc.text: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.

decoDesc.text: Pursuant to relevant provisions of the Band Accord, all Accordatories shall, while ensuring the unimpeded circulation of Talosian Credit Notes in the civilian economy, maintain commodity stockpiles to cover the issuance of such stock bills, thereby facilitating orderly and effective joint stockpile redistribution under exceptional circumstances.

desc.text: Stock bills issued in Wuling and only usable in the said region. They have all sorts of uses.

decoDesc.text: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. Amethyst is the main material used for producing this.

desc.text: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.

decoDesc.text: Pursuant to relevant provisions of the Band Accord, all signatories shall, in addition to simultaneously guaranteeing that Talosian Credit Notes provide a currency circulation sufficient for the civil economy, guarantee a commodity stockpile sufficient for the agreed-upon supply of such types of allocation orders so as to achieve an orderly and effective joint allocation during extraordinary circumstances.

desc.text: Stock bills issued in Valley IV and only usable in the said region. They have all sorts of uses.
